description: Acquisition d’un véhicule neuf pour la Commission Communale des Feux de Forêt (C.C.F.F.) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brignoles. Il s’agit de l’acquisition d’un véhicule VL type pick-up 4x4. Les caractéristiques demandées sont détaillées au Cahier des Clauses Particulières (C.C.P.). Le marché commencent à sa date de notification. Le délai d’exécution (livraison), débute à la réception de la lettre de notification valant bon de commande. Coverage: Commune de Brignoles. The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brignoles. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
